qualifier: and incretin-stimulated insulin processing and secretion
name: Pancreatic endocrine development and incretin-stimulated insulin secretion
rationale: Members span pancreatic progenitor lineages, endocrine/neuroendocrine differentiation and beta-cell insulin processing with GLP-1/GIP-driven secretion; the insulin/incretin arm separates it from ductal/endoderm confusables and the development arm from secretion-only confusables.

name: Lactate, pyruvate and di/tricarboxylate transmembrane transport
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated transport of monocarboxylates (MCT/basigin, lactate, pyruvate) and TCA intermediates (malate-aspartate shuttle, succinate, alpha-ketoglutarate, citrate), distinct from the carnitine, choline and cationic amino acid transport of the confusables.

name: Nucleosome assembly including centromeric CENP-A deposition
rationale: All members concern loading histones/nucleosomes onto chromatin, with CENP-A deposition at centromeres distinguishing it from chromosome condensation and histone acetylation confusables.

core: Neurotransmitter precursor and organic cation transport
qualifier: choline and GABA uptake with synaptic vesicle loading
name: Choline and GABA uptake and synaptic vesicle loading
rationale: Members cover SLC uptake of choline (SLC5A7), GABA and organic cations plus vesicular neurotransmitter loading and acidification, distinguishing it from monoamine uptake, glutamate/GABA metabolism and cholinergic transmission confusables.

qualifier: dendritic cell and lymphocyte migration signalling
name: Dendritic cell and lymphocyte homing chemotactic signalling
rationale: The four members (lymphocyte homing adhesion, myeloid DC chemotaxis, PLC/PKC and Cdc42 signalling) describe chemokine-driven leukocyte homing; DC chemotaxis with its intracellular signalling separates it from B/T cell migration and synapse confusables.

core: NK and CD8 T cell cytotoxicity
name: NK and CD8 T cell cytotoxic activation
rationale: Members are NK and CD8 T cell signatures and positive regulation of their cytotoxicity, degranulation and proliferation, unlike confusables centred on KIR inhibition, negative regulation and tolerance.

name: Glucose-activated ChREBP metabolic gene transcription
rationale: Members describe transcriptional responses to glucose/carbon source, including PP2A dephosphorylation and activation of ChREBP; this glucose-activation arm separates it from adipogenesis, LXR/SREBP and PKA/AMPK inhibitory confusables.

name: ER protein quality control, retention and retrotranslocation
rationale: Members cover ER lumen retention, regulation of ER exit, ERQC demannosylation, ufmylation and ERAD retrotranslocation, distinguishing it from COPII export and SRP membrane-insertion confusables.

name: Regulation of p53-mediated DNA damage-induced intrinsic apoptosis
rationale: All members are GO terms for positive or negative regulation of p53-mediated DNA-damage and intrinsic apoptotic signalling, unlike confusables listing TP53 transcriptional targets, cell-cycle arrest or senescence.

qualifier: raft/caveolae, integrin-ILK adhesion and electrical coupling
name: Cardiomyocyte membrane rafts, integrin-ILK adhesion and electrical coupling
rationale: Members combine T-tubule and raft/caveolar organization, PINCH-ILK-parvin integrin adhesion, gap junction and action potential regulation, separating it from sarcomere contraction and desmosome confusables.

name: Selenium metabolism, H2O2 and thyroid hormone homeostasis
rationale: Members cover selenium compound metabolism and selenocysteine synthesis, H2O2 production/catabolism and thyroid hormone generation, transport and signalling, distinguishing it from vitamin C, generic ROS detoxification and sulfate/iodide transport confusables.

name: Chylomicron and VLDL assembly
rationale: All members describe assembly of triglyceride-carrying lipoproteins, while confusables cover their remodeling and clearance.

qualifier: O-GalNAc glycosylation and fucosylated/sialylated blood group epitopes
name: O-GalNAc glycosylation and fucosylated, sialylated terminal epitope synthesis
rationale: Members cover mucin-type O-glycan initiation and termination (GALNTs, C1GALT1C1), poly-LacNAc extension, sialylation and fucosylated ABO/Lewis/selectin-ligand epitopes, unlike confusables on GDP-fucose synthesis, sulfation, N-glycan trimming or sialic acid metabolism.

qualifier: by CBL and SRC family kinases
name: CBL- and SRC kinase-mediated regulation of FLT3 signalling
rationale: All four members concern wild-type FLT3 signalling through SRC kinases and its CBL-dependent negative regulation, unlike confusables on drug-resistant FLT3 mutants or RUNX transcription.

name: Mammary gland and placental trophoblast development
rationale: Members split between mammary lineage, branching and lactation and placental trophoblast, labyrinth and decidual development, together distinguishing it from involution, early embryo and prostate/genital confusables.

name: Rac and Cdc42 GTPase cycles driving Arp2/3 lamellipodia
rationale: Members are RAC1-3, CDC42, RHOJ and RHOG cycles with WASP/WAVE-Arp2/3 actin nucleation and lamellipodium assembly, separating it from RhoA/B/C-formin and NADPH oxidase confusables.

qualifier: growth factor receptor downregulation via multivesicular body
name: Ubiquitin-dependent endocytic downregulation of growth factor receptors
rationale: Members cover ubiquitin/clathrin-mediated internalization and MVB sorting of RTKs such as EGFR and MET (InlB entry), distinguishing it from ESCRT budding/viral release and MET/PTK6 signalling confusables.

qualifier: intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct and ureteric bud formation
name: Nephric duct and ureteric bud induction from intermediate mesoderm
rationale: Members trace intermediate mesoderm to nephric duct and ureteric bud formation and branching, unlike confusables on nephron tubule morphogenesis or ureteric bud elongation and ureter development.

qualifier: class I hematopoietic/hormone receptors and oncogenic kinase fusions via STAT5
name: Class I cytokine, hormone and oncogenic kinase JAK-STAT signalling
rationale: Members are JAK-STAT3/5 signalling by IL-2/3/5/6/7/9/11, LIF/CNTF, EPO, TPO, GH, prolactin and leptin receptors plus FLT3 and PDGFR/FGFR fusions, separating it from IL-10/12/23/27/15/21 and Th2/mast cell confusables.

name: Lymphocyte immunological synapse, raft polarization and heterotypic adhesion
rationale: Members cover T cell synapse formation, raft localization, polarity, aggregation and PECAM1/heterotypic adhesion, distinguishing it from integrin-activation and CORO1A/second-messenger confusables.

name: Integrin activation promoting heterotypic cell-cell adhesion
rationale: All members describe integrin activation and heterotypic membrane docking/adhesion including PECAM1, unlike confusables on leukocyte-endothelial adhesion inhibition, Rap1-MAPK integrin signalling or T cell synapse formation.

name: Amino acid and energy sensing regulating mTORC1
rationale: Members describe mTORC1 control by leucine/amino acids and glucose/LKB1-AMPK energy status, unlike confusables on mTORC1 target gene programs, glycolysis, amino acid transport or AKT-FOXO.

name: Plasma lipoprotein remodeling and clearance
rationale: Members cover LDL/HDL remodeling and clearance of LDL, VLDL and chylomicrons with cholesterol import and lipoprotein signalling, distinguishing it from lipoprotein assembly, lipase activation and intestinal absorption confusables.

name: Mitotic centrosome maturation, microtubule nucleation and anchoring
rationale: Members concern centrosome protein recruitment (AURKA-TPX2, NuMA, Nlp), centrosome positioning and MTOC microtubule nucleation/anchoring for spindle assembly, unlike broad mitosis, APC/C and spindle orientation/cilium confusables.

name: Circadian clock transcription and sleep/wake regulation
rationale: Members combine BMAL1:CLOCK/NPAS-driven and FOXO/NPAS4 transcription with sleep/wake, locomotor rhythm and clock-linked beta-cell regulation, distinguishing it from orexin/feeding and gluconeogenic confusables.
